title: SimpliSafe Alarm Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplisafe:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(sensor_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many SimpliSafe alarm event events land each day and how many distinct sensor values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest SimpliSafe alarm event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct sensor values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly how much SimpliSafe alarm event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
